stories.title: Solar, wind and batteries can deliver firm power at $0.086/kWh, says Ember
stories.description: An analysis by Ember finds that adding wind power to solar PV and battery storage systems reduces the median cost of meeting 90% of electricity demand from $105/MWh to $86/MWh. The cost could fall further to $52/MWh by 2050, based on the regional cost projections used in the model.

stories.title: PV and batteries could help cut global power costs by 40% in 2030s
stories.description: A Schneider Electric Research Institute analysis of 40,500 scenarios finds that coordinated investment in distributed solar, battery energy storage and electrified demand could reduce total global electricity system costs by up to 40% in the 2030s, provided technology costs fall as projected.

stories.title: Vulcan rocket fails during launch, dealing major blow to SpaceX competitors
stories.description: This was the first total mission failure in United Launch Alliance's 20-year history.

stories.title: OpenAI board member worries an AI "takeover" of society could be months away
stories.description: Researcher traces a path from AI reward hacking to potential human extinction.

stories.title: Helsing backer Plural raises $1.1B to fund Europe’s next moonshots
stories.description: Operator-led VC firm Plural has raised €1 billion in new capital ($1.1 billion), joining a growing cohort of larger European funds that also includes Mundi Ventures’ Kembara and EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund.

stories.title: After dodging death, battery startup Our Next Energy is now going public
stories.description: Our Next Energy is the latest battery startup to go public via SPAC. Does it now have what it needs to survive in a the cutthroat battery industry?

stories.title: Five EU countries expected to announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
stories.description: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands are expected to announce a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.

stories.title: Ashes of exiled Nobel Laureate Miguel Ángel Asturias returned to Guatemala
stories.description: The poet, writer and diplomat died in Europe in 1974 having been forced to leave his native country.

stories.title: A common osteoporosis drug blocked spinal damage in a surprising new study
stories.description: Scientists have uncovered a surprising genetic connection to spinal degeneration and found that an existing osteoporosis drug can prevent damaging mineral buildup in zebrafish spines. The discovery could pave the way for new treatments that slow or prevent a major cause of chronic back pain.

stories.title: ParetoM$^3$: Learning on the Pareto Set under Preference Guidance via Min-Max-Min Optimization
stories.description: arXiv:2611.18252v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learning across multiple inherently conflicting objectives requires selecting desirable trade-offs from the Pareto set. In this work, we study preference-guided multi-objective optimization, where a predefined preference function is minimized over the weak Pareto set of multiple nonconvex objectives.

stories.title: South Korea opens storage subsidy call for community solar villages
stories.description: The South Korean government has opened applications for a program that supports energy storage run by virtual power plant (VPP) operators in grid-saturated areas, where it is promoting solar villages.

stories.title: Vitamin C could help block cancer-linked chemicals in your stomach, study finds
stories.description: Scientists have discovered that vitamin C may help prevent potentially cancer-causing chemicals from forming in the stomach after eating foods containing nitrates and nitrites. A new mathematical model suggests that taking vitamin C after meals could reduce these harmful reactions, offering a possible new strategy for lowering cancer risk.
